title: All delete methods not working nor is new folder created
creator: pyxis
content:
Reinstall of Thunderbird after a few years easy with all my old (sub) folders captured from service provider. However, neither delete folder (via any option) nor create folder is acted upon. Also ignored is attempt to rename a folder. Inbox contains over 23 000 messages but none after 5 December 2025. Deleting hundreds permanently on provider has no effect on Thunderbird. Some folders are empty but but are labelled as containing hundreds of messages.

Trying to send a message results in error, 'Could not detect login form.' But I am logged in.

Any pointers to unclogging system gratefully received. Chris Oldman

title: Emails are taking "forever" to delete, plus 2 crashes
creator: really2
content:
I'm using Thunderbird 115.18.0 and just today it's behaving bizarrely. Crashed twice for no reason, and emails are taking "forever" to delete -- normally they delete immediately (unless they have an enormous attachment), but today I have to wait about 4 seconds for one short text only email to delete. Compacted folders, and made no difference.

Any ideas? Anything I can do to return to my normal I love Thunderbird condition?

Thanks.

title: Server name field is auto filled and mispelled so I can not create a new email account.
creator: david955
content:
I have set up 4 email accounts in Thunderbird. I tried today to set up another email account with the same domain. selected the New Account Button (email only); then pop up screen to add name of account user and users email address. next menu, TB was successful finding the server but a small yellow flag says "unknown hostname" but lists the 3rd party host, that there is SSL/TSL security and the user name matches the new account information just entered. Incoming settings looked correct. The next screen is Choose email account type and it was auto populated by TB and all info is correct. Next, enter password (for new account?) and TB fails to create a new account. Says Authentication error unable to log in at server. Tried doing the manual config. Outgoing server protocol shows SMPT when it should be IMAP (correct?) but the field is un-selectable. So results are same, Unable to log in to server.

the manual config screen has a host name field and it is autofilled with my company's name.domain but it is misspelled! Tried to edit but no success. I really need to get this new account up quick! So asking for any help available.
